description: Combines the Base token-report risk tier and flags, available DEX market data, and wallet-audit risk tier, flags, account nonce, and native balance. Returns the underlying indicators separately; it does not generate buy/sell recommendations or calibrated confidence, and does not evaluate holder concentration. The account nonce is not full transaction, token-transfer, or trading history. Use as one input before a Base trade. Costs $0.05 in USDC on Base per successful call, paid with x402.

token.description: Token contract address on Base, 0x-prefixed 20-byte hex
